tasks.prompt: Write a complete Java 17 public class Main. Read four signed integers a b c d from standard input describing half-open minute intervals [a,b) and [c,d), with a<=b and c<=d. Print the number of integer minutes in their intersection followed by a newline.

Write a complete Java 17 public class Main. Read exactly one input line; remove leading and trailing ASCII space characters and replace every run of ASCII spaces with one ASCII space. Print the result followed by a newline. Do not change tabs or non-ASCII whitespace.

Write a complete Java 17 public class Main. Read an integer n followed by n signed integers on standard input (0 <= n <= 1000). Print the smallest positive integer not present in the n numbers, followed by one newline.
